AB=BC=x,\quad AC=b,\quad AI=CI=y.
\]
Since \(I\) lies on the symmetry axis of the isosceles triangle, \(\triangle AIC\) is isosceles.

\[

\]

\[
b=2x\cos\theta.
\]

\[

\]

\[
\frac{2x+b}{2y+b}=\frac{125}{6}.
\]

\[
6(2x+b)=125(2y+b)
\]
\[
12x=119b+250y.
\]

Let \(r=\frac{b}{y}\). From the geometry relation,
\[
\frac{x}{y}=\frac{r}{r^2-2}.
\]

\[
12\cdot \frac{r}{r^2-2}=119r+250.
\]
This simplifies to
\[
119r^3+250r^2-250r-500=0.
\]

\[
(7r-10)(17r^2+60r+50)=0.

\[

\]

\[
\frac{x}{y}=\frac{r}{r^2-2}
=\frac{10/7}{100/49-2}

\]
so
\[
x=35y=35(7k)=245k.
\]
